To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: OmniHealth Procurement <procure@omnihealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jun 2028 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood demo follow-up — hosted API pricing and pilot next steps

David / Marissa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. OmniHealth is excited by the latency profile and the KV-caching notes — we think this could materially improve our patient triage LLM. We are ready to move from pilot to production but need a commercial model that makes unit economics work at scale.

High-level ask: 12-month commitment with an initial ramp to 3B tokens/month by month 6. Target blended discount in the ~25% range off list for Hosted API usage (we can provide a forecast and clause for guaranteed minimums). This is above the standard published tiers and will require executive approval on your side.

Can you share the mutual action plan and a draft SOW so we can run procurement? Attaching our initial requirements doc.

Claire

Head of Integrations, OmniHealth Systems

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Jun 2028 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Exec request: 25% hosted-API concession for OmniHealth (DL-2028-1378)

Team —

Summary: OmniHealth requests a one-year commitment with a tiered usage ramp (month 1: 100M tokens, month 6: 3B tokens, steady-state 3.5B). They want a blended 25% discount on Hosted API list pricing. This exceeds standard approval matrix (>20%), so I’m escalating for exec authorization.

Why approve?
- Strategic: OmniHealth is a marquee healthcare customer that accelerates our presence in the EHR-integrations market and unlocks referrals to two payer partners.
- Revenue: Projected committed ARR = $3.2M (year 1), with conservative adoption assumptions; upside via add-ons (dedicated routing, extra storage).
- Churn risk low: procurement requires 12-month minimum and an early-termination fee tied to committed tokens.
- Operational fit: Workload profile favors our batching + caching optimizations; expected token cost to Redwood is ~40% of net revenue at proposed price, acceptable with forecasted margins.

Files attached: SOW, detailed token model, concession form with approval fields.

Ask: Approval for 25% off list for Hosted API usage, conditional on a 12-month minimum and the attached fallbacks (performance SLOs, minimum monthly commits). If approved, I will finalize the concession in the contract and send the DocuSign link to Omni procurement.

Ben Carter
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Concession_Form_25pct.docx (DOCX)]

Ben — quick clarifying Qs before I loop in finance/legal for final sign-off:
1) Can you attach the month-by-month commit table and the early-termination fee language you propose?
2) Do we have telemetry/accepted test results from the pilot that validate the latency targets (we need this for our SLO carve-outs)?
3) Confirm whether marketplace listing or co-marketing is part of the commitment (this can influence margin calculus).

If you can get those in the next 24 hours I’ll push to approve.

-Marissa
